description: This file manages theme settings and application for a web application, including theme toggling, event handling, and theme persistence.

methods.name: applyTheme
methods.description: Initializes and applies the theme based on user settings and system preferences.

methods.name: addThemeListener
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked when the theme changes.

methods.name: removeThemeListener
methods.description: Unregisters a previously added theme change callback.

methods.name: currentTheme
methods.description: Retrieves the current theme setting from persistent storage.

methods.name: currentDocumentTheme
methods.description: Determines the current theme applied to the document based on CSS classes.

methods.name: useThemeSetting
methods.description: React hook to get and set the theme setting.
